newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Trade in Brazil's Banco Excel Economico begins.
newsitem.headline: Trade in Brazil's Banco Excel Economico begins.

text.p: SAO PAULO, Sept 25 (Reuter) The Sao Paulo Stock Exchange said trade in preferred and common shares of Banco Excel Economico will begin today on the bolsa's electronic system.
The bourse said in a statement that the company's trading code is BEX and the shares will be traded in lots of 1,000 shares.
The bank was formed after Banco Excel earlier this year acquired assets of failed bank Banco Economico.
